name: comp-159
blurb: Cards arranged vertically, one radio button selected at a time.
description: Radio group options rendered as selectable cards with labels and descriptions. Built on shadcn's RadioGroup primitive.
use_when: Displaying multiple mutually exclusive options that benefit from card-style presentation with descriptive text.
avoid_when: Very long lists of options — cards take up more space than compact radio buttons.
a11y: Built on accessible RadioGroup primitive with proper labels, aria-describedby, and focus management.
